I have been farming this land since I was young, and I learned from my mother how to grow beans between the maize stalks. My husband and I have 2.89 hectares altogether, but this 0.40-hectare plot is my beans patch, and I look after it myself. I do not have spare cash to buy fertilizer for beans when my maize plot already needs whatever coupon I can get from the subsidy program, and beans fix their own nitrogen anyway. I will use the manure I saved from our goats and chickens because the land is ours and I want to keep it healthy, but I will plant the same local bean seed I kept from last year's harvest since it still grows well and I do not need to spend money at the market.
